notice: Declarative metadata only. Packs never create authority; every action is still decided at runtime by the Guardian authority path under a human's policy.

tierLegend.governed: Built-in actions and existing adapters cover the vertical's actions.
tierLegend.integration-ready: Governed decision path; the external adapters are declared but not yet built.
tierLegend.production-integrated: At least one action carries recorded external-system proof (LIVE_PROVEN).

maturityLegend.L1: Built-in governed: decided on the canonical authority path.
maturityLegend.L2: Schema/kernel capable: modeled and decidable; adapter not production-proven.
maturityLegend.L3: Production integrated: requires recorded real external-system proof.
